entry_points.summary: Appends structured JSON event to run events.jsonl and repo-wide metrics.jsonl; flock-safe; sources plan-path.sh.
Sugar over log-event.sh; start/end/wrap modes emit <phase>_start/_end with wall_ms; python3 ms-timestamp fallback for macOS; anomaly detection via check_wall_ms.
Anomaly guard: emits telemetry_anomaly and suppresses *_end event when wall_ms > 604_800_000ms or wall_ms < 0.
Scans docs/llm/*.json, collects memories[], sorts by slug asc/date desc, writes MEMORIES-FLAT.md atomically via os.replace.
Emits JSON blob with plugin git SHA, dirty flag, branch, optional tag; resolves plugin root via four env vars.
Gate script for memory-review agent; <RUN> <parent_command>; 4-state terminal taxonomy; 5-line stdout contract on ready.
CLI: extracts dismissed finding signatures from consecutive archive run pairs; --global and --filename flags; outputs {signatures,n_runs_scanned}.
Pairwise algorithm: R_i snapshot vs R_{i+1}.previous-* user-edited copy to find dismissed findings.
Rsync local tree to two-level remote layout: <slug>/base/ (seeded once, atomic mkdir lock) + <slug>/<task-id>/ overlay via --link-dest; REMOTE_HOME resolved via SSH printf; SLUG/TASK_ID validated.
Acquires remote lock via mkdir, seeds shared base via rsync, writes .base-ready marker with HEAD SHA, releases lock; losers poll up to 600s.

Layered TOML config loader; subcommands: get, export-env, ensure-defaults, explain, should-notify, list-question-ids, resolve-question, check-no-ask, set, migrate, inspect-all; QUESTION_IDS registry + RESULT_MAP + [followup] section; startup guards at module load.
Module-load guard: asserts QUESTION_IDS keys exist in VALIDATORS, have skill_default, RESULT_MAP choices are valid; exits 2 on violation.
Prints sorted JSON array of registered question IDs from QUESTION_IDS registry.

Returns JSON resolver envelope {result,default,source,rule_id,strength,reason,sources}; result in {ask,skip,prefill,halt,defer-to-sink}; consults 4-layer config then routing-preference memories; honors Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL, Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK, Z_HARNESS_EXPLAIN_RESOLUTION.
Returns JSON {result:halt|proceed, question_id, rule_id}; fail-closed gate for overnight mode; unregistered qids always halt with unknown_ask_blocked event.
Atomic read-modify-write of config key in global or project TOML; validates key+value before writing; exit 2 on validation, 4 on I/O.
Thin shell wrapper: exec python3 scripts/config.py "$@".
Classifies terminal state of a run as clean|halted|errored|unknown; subcommands: classify <run-id-or-path> [--command <name>], last-event <run-id-or-path>; sources plan-path.sh.
Matches event kind against clean allowlist, halt allowlist, and *_error/fatal pattern; returns one of four terminal states.
Subcommand entry; implement-all special case: requires last event=implement_end|compaction_pause AND all TASKS.md checkboxes [x]|[~] for clean.
Resets - [~] in-progress markers to - [ ] in <plan-dir>/TASKS.md; atomic via .tmp.$$ rename; always exits 0; --self-test mode with 4 assertions.
Audits AskUserQuestion callsites in commands/ and skills/; tags REGISTERED (file also has resolve-question or check-no-ask) or UNREGISTERED; --strict exits 1 on unregistered.
Phase-0 preflight for /z-overnight; check-collisions --chain <steps> --base <dir>: exits 0 if safe, emits slug_collision_halt event and exits 1 on collision; --self-test runs 8 assertions.
v1 rule (SPEC C13): collision when first chain step is plan|research AND <base>/PLAN.md exists; cds to REPO_ROOT before calling log-event.sh.
Locates latest overnight run dir, loads overnight-state.json + events.jsonl, calls generate_report, writes MORNING_REPORT.md atomically; exits 1 on I/O or parse error.
Assembles five sections: chain summary (HEAD SHA mismatch banner), phase results table, unilateral decisions table, test outcomes, recommended next (branches on halt reason).
Golden-file comparison against fixtures in z-harness/overnight-run/tests/morning-report-fixtures/; runs root fixture + subdirs with MORNING_REPORT.md.golden.
Local pre-commit/pre-PR harness; runs lint-askuser.sh --strict; maps exit 1 to advisory warning, propagates exit 2+ as hard failures.

End-to-end smoke tests for config.py; 18+ test classes with hermetic XDG_CONFIG_HOME temp dirs; covers defaults, env overrides, repo-local precedence, schema errors, ensure-defaults, export-env dedup, resolve-question, overnight overrides, check-no-ask, list-question-ids, 3-level nesting (roles.*), migrate, _KEY_RE.
Bash regression harness for log-phase.sh; 4 TEST groups, 21 assertions; hermetic via Z_HARNESS_PLANS_DIR+Z_HARNESS_SLUG temp dirs; covers overflow, normal path, negative wall_ms, 26h false-positive.
Generic per-entry fcntl.flock + heartbeat + stale-takeover primitive; subcommands: acquire, heartbeat, release, check-stale [--ttl-seconds=N]; exit 0=acquired,1=contention,2=stale-takeover,3=corrupt.

Forks a background daemon that takes LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB on .flock sentinel; daemon holds the flock for the lock's lifetime and records its own PID (os.getpid()) in the JSON. Stale-takeover (exit 2) if PID dead or heartbeat > TTL; contention (exit 1) if live daemon holds flock. Stale-takeover IS possible even when LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB fails — if JSON is stale the takeover path kills the old daemon, waits for flock freedom, then spawns a new daemon.

Writer primitive for follow-up sink; parses --sink, --priority, --name, --recommended-command, --source-artifact, --cited-paths, optional flags; delegates to sink-add-helpers.py. Exit 0=success,2=validation,3=dedup-skip,4=depth-exceeded,5=lock-timeout,6=diffuse-cited-paths.

Full writer pipeline: depth check → validate → compute hashes → pre-lock dedup → build entry → acquire global lock → TOCTOU dedup recheck → write prompt-page → append entry_created → rebuild view → optional Notion push → emit followup_created.
SHA-256 of name+NUL+recommended_command+NUL+source_artifact; dedup key; computed before and rechecked after global lock acquisition.

Atomic open→running claim; flags: --entry, --run, --sink-root, --allow-stale; prints claim ticket JSON on exit 0. Exit 0=success,2=validation,3=not-claimable,4=staleness-drift,5=lock-timeout,7=depth-1-refusal.

Full claim sequence: per-entry lock first (mandatory) → stale-takeover recovery → depth-1 refusal → status==open check → staleness check → global lock second → append status_changed open→running → rebuild view → release global lock. Per-entry lock stays held by caller.

Generic status transition primitive; flags: --entry, --to, --by, --sink-root, optional --evidence, --reason, --completion-mode, --via-claim-ticket. Exit 0=success,2=validation,3=illegal-transition,4=evidence-rejected,5=lock-timeout,6=completion-mode-conflict.

Drives seven-state machine (open/running/verify/done/failed/blocked/dismissed); validates transition via ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS; verifies/re-acquires per-entry lock; acquires global lock; runs audit+auto-close checks; enforces completion_mode mutex; appends status_changed; rebuilds view.
Must be called with global lock held; verifies lock via JSON content OR OS flock; delegates to sink-view-reducer.py. Exit 4 if called without lock held.
Reads index.jsonl line-by-line; applies entry_created, status_changed, evidence_attached, dismissed, closed events; unknown kinds warned+skipped; never crash.
Writes index.view.json atomically via tmpfile+rename in same directory; JSON pretty-printed with indent=2, sort_keys=True.

11-point check on audit_evidence.json vs entry JSON: file exists, schema_version==1, required fields, entry_id match, z_review_all_verdict==PASS, test_exit_code==0, cumulative_diff present, cited_paths exist, recommended_command unchanged, capture_head unchanged, reviewer_notes non-empty.
CLI: argv[1]=evidence path, argv[2]=entry JSON path, argv[3]=optional repo_root; prints {passed,rejected_check,reason} JSON; exits 0 on pass, 1 on fail.

Auto-close ceiling check: reads allowlist/denylist from config, parses diff stat, checks auto_close_eligible+completion_mode+test_exit; pass=noop OR docs_only; outputs {passed,reason,mode} JSON; exits 0 on pass, 1 on fail.

One-way idempotent Notion push; token from Z_HARNESS_NOTION_TOKEN env or secrets.toml; queries for existing page by z_harness_entry_id; creates or skips; retries 3x with backoff [1,4,16]s. Exit 0=success,4=retry-exhausted,5=idempotency-mismatch,6=auth-missing,7=config-missing.
Thin shell wrapper: exec python3 followup-reconcile-notion-impl.py "$@"; accepts --project-sink-root, --global-sink-root, --dry-run.

Sweeps project+global sinks; re-invokes notion-push.py for each notion_sync_pending entry; on success appends notion_synced+notion_sync_cleared events; outputs {swept_count,succeeded,failed,conflicts} JSON; exits 0 always.

Tolerant parser: reads reviewer output from --reviewer-output or stdin; finds **FOLLOWUPS:** + ```json fence; validates required fields per entry; per-entry errors log+skip; outputs JSON list (may be []); logs followup_block_parse_failed on parse failure; exits 0 on empty result.
JSON Schema test runner (draft-2020-12); 3 followup-entry fixtures + 2 audit-evidence fixtures + mutex test + enum literal tests via Python jsonschema; exits 0 on all pass, 1 on any fail.

invariants: All scripts require python3 for JSON handling, timing fallbacks, and document generation.
All scripts resolve the repo root via git rev-parse or pwd fallback.
log-event.sh and log-phase.sh honor Z_HARNESS_SLUG for slug-namespaced vs. legacy flat plan layout.
log-event.sh sources scripts/plan-path.sh for canonical and legacy plan path resolution.
log-phase.sh check_wall_ms emits telemetry_anomaly and suppresses *_end event when wall_ms > 604_800_000ms (overflow) or wall_ms < 0 (clock skew); exits 0 in both anomaly cases.
regenerate-memories-flat.py writes MEMORIES-FLAT.md atomically via os.replace on a PID+random-suffixed temp file.
run-memory-review.sh always exits 0; skip conditions are communicated via STATUS: line on stdout.
run-memory-review.sh accepts exactly two positional args: <RUN> <parent_command>.

run-memory-review.sh stdout line 1 is always STATUS: ready | STATUS: skipped <reason>; lines 2-4 are diff, SPEC (or empty), TAGS paths when ready; line 5 is DEBUG.md path when parent_command is debug.

run-memory-review.sh emits exactly one memory_review_terminal event on all skip paths using a 4-state taxonomy: skipped_broken_context, not_applicable, ready (orchestrator-owned), dispatched (orchestrator-owned).
extract-dismissals.py outputs JSON {signatures, n_runs_scanned} to stdout; exit 0 even when no dismissals found.
extract-dismissals.py --global applies the pairwise algorithm within each slug independently, not across slugs.
The env var for the plan base dir is Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR (singular, not PLANS_DIR).
config.py _run_startup_guards() runs at module load and exits 2 on any QUESTION_IDS/VALIDATORS/RESULT_MAP inconsistency.
config.py resolve-question returns a JSON envelope with result in {ask, skip, prefill, halt, defer-to-sink} (resolver result-domain); RESULT_MAP handles option-to-result translation.
config.py resolve-question stdout is reserved for the JSON envelope; all diagnostics route to stderr.
config.py resolve-question exits 5 when Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL=1 and Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt are both set.
config.py check-no-ask is fail-closed: unregistered question_ids return halt when Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt.
config.py set performs atomic read-modify-write via temp-file rename; validates key format and value against VALIDATORS before writing; exit 2 on validation, 4 on I/O.
config.py export-env emits config_resolved event at most once per Z_HARNESS_RUN via O_EXCL stamp file in TMPDIR.
remote-sandbox-sync.sh two-level layout: base/ seeded once per slug with atomic remote mkdir lock; per-task overlay uses --link-dest for hard-linked unchanged files.
remote-sandbox-sync.sh resolves REMOTE_HOME via ssh printf (tilde expansion unreliable in --link-dest).
remote-sandbox-sync.sh TASK_ID rejects the literal value 'base' and all path-traversal patterns.
run-status.sh always exits 0; terminal state is communicated as a printed string on stdout.
run-status.sh classify with --command implement-all requires both a clean last-event kind AND all TASKS.md checkboxes [x]|[~] before returning clean.
normalize-task-state.sh always exits 0 (best-effort); no events emitted.
normalize-task-state.sh only rewrites the - [~] prefix; - [ ] and - [x] markers are never modified.
overnight-preflight.sh check-collisions exits 0 when the chain's first step is not plan or research, regardless of artifacts.
overnight-preflight.sh cds to REPO_ROOT before calling log-event.sh to ensure canonical path resolution regardless of caller cwd.
morning-report.py writes MORNING_REPORT.md atomically via tempfile + os.rename; exits 1 on missing overnight-state.json.
morning-report.py finds the latest run by lexical sort of directories containing '-overnight-' in the archive dir.
lint-askuser.sh classification is file-level: all AskUserQuestion callsites in a file tagged REGISTERED if the file also contains resolve-question or check-no-ask anywhere.
preflight.sh maps lint-askuser.sh exit 1 to advisory warning; exit 2+ propagates as hard failure.
sink-lock.sh uses a separate .flock sentinel file (same path + '.flock') to hold the OS-level fcntl.flock exclusive lock; the JSON content file is only ever written under this lock.
sink-lock.sh stale-takeover fires when PID is dead OR last_heartbeat age >= TTL (either condition alone is sufficient).

sink-lock.sh holder PID is the background daemon's own os.getpid(), NOT os.getppid() (the shell caller). The daemon is a long-lived Python process that holds the flock fd open for the lock's lifetime; its PID is what is recorded in the JSON holder record and what stale-takeover kills.
sink-add-helpers.py dedup check runs twice: before the global lock (cheap path) and again under the lock (TOCTOU-safe).
sink-add-helpers.py cited_paths > 16 switches from individual file_blob_hashes to a dir tree hash; ancestor depth < 2 from repo root is rejected with exit 6.
sink-add-helpers.py MAX_DEPTH=1: Z_HARNESS_FOLLOWUP_CALLER_DEPTH > 1 is rejected with exit 4 (depth-exceeded).
sink-claim-helpers.py mandatory lock-ordering: per-entry lock FIRST, global lock SECOND. Inverting this order risks deadlock.
sink-claim-helpers.py depth-1 entries are refused with exit 7; they are considered inert and must not be claimed by consumers.
sink-status-set-impl.py ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS defines the complete state machine; all unlisted (from, to) pairs are illegal and exit 3.
sink-status-set-impl.py completion_mode is a mutex: only one of human_confirmed, audit_confirmed, auto_closed_low_risk may be set per entry; re-setting to a different non-null mode exits 6.
sink-view-rebuild.sh must be called with global lock already held by caller; exits 4 if lock is free.
sink-view-reducer.py is forward-compatible: unknown event kinds and unknown fields within known events are silently skipped; the script never crashes on unexpected input.
sink-view-reducer.py writes index.view.json atomically via tmpfile+rename in the same sink-root directory.
sink-audit-validate.py 11 checks run in order and short-circuit on the first failure; rejected_check in output JSON is the 1-based check number that failed.
sink-auto-close-check.py denylist takes precedence over allowlist; a path matching both is treated as denied.
notion-push.py idempotency: queries Notion for existing page by z_harness_entry_id property before creating; exit 5 on mismatch.
notion-push.py token resolution order: Z_HARNESS_NOTION_TOKEN env var first, then secrets.toml.
followup-reconcile-notion-impl.py always exits 0 (best-effort sweep; not a transaction).
parse-followups-block.py always exits 0 on empty result (even after parse failure); only exits 1 on fatal I/O error.
validate-followup-schemas.sh exits 2 (before assertions) if Python jsonschema library or schema/fixture files are missing.
gotchas: log-phase.sh check_wall_ms threshold 604_800_000ms catches seconds-vs-ms overflow (1500x headroom); wall_ms_negative covers NTP jumps / clock skew.

config.py startup guards check: every QUESTION_IDS key exists in VALIDATORS; every entry has non-null skill_default; every RESULT_MAP (question_id, choice) references known question_id and valid choice.
config.py resolve-question: Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL=1 short-circuits to result=ask regardless of config/memory; Z_HARNESS_EXPLAIN_RESOLUTION=1 enables verbose stderr explain output.
config.py resolve-question: Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt activates _apply_overnight_overrides; allowlist hits return overnight_decision envelope; non-allowlist hits return halt envelope.
config.py resolve-question: workflow.spec_retro_discovery can return defer-to-sink when set to defer_to_sink_p2; callers must handle this result by invoking sink-add.sh instead of prompting.
config.py resolve-question reads routing-preference memories from docs/llm/*.json (harness-repo-relative, not project-relative); project scope filtering uses Z_HARNESS_PROJECT_ROOT or git rev-parse.
config.py resolve-question conflict resolution: config non-default AND memory disagrees -> result=ask source=conflict; multiple disagreeing memory entries also -> result=ask source=conflict.
config.py check-no-ask: unregistered question_id always halts (fail-closed) and emits unknown_ask_blocked event when Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt.
config.py set default scope is project; pass --scope=global for global config; uses require_exists=False so it creates the file if absent.
config.py global layer validation failures emit WARNING and fall back to default (soft fail); repo/env layer failures exit 2 (hard fail).

run-memory-review.sh 4-state terminal taxonomy: skipped_broken_context (missing_args, no_plan_dir, tags_missing), not_applicable (empty_diff, all_tasks_skipped, debug_md_missing); ready and dispatched are orchestrator-owned.
run-memory-review.sh parent_command=debug adds third skip condition: STATUS: skipped debug_md_missing if DEBUG.md absent or unreadable; state=not_applicable.
macOS BSD date lacks %3N support; log-phase.sh falls back to python3 time.time()*1000.
log-event.sh silently wraps non-JSON payloads as {"raw": ...} instead of failing.
log-event.sh mid-flight legacy detection: writes to old flat path if run dir already exists there.
run-memory-review.sh disables pipefail around git diff | head -n 5000 to tolerate SIGPIPE.
version.sh degrades gracefully if plugin root is not a git repo, returning non-git sentinel values.
extract-dismissals.py drops findings lacking a title field; does NOT fall back to T-MR-NNN ids (renumbered each run, would produce spurious dismissal matches).
extract-dismissals.py --filename allows targeting PLAN_STYLE_AUDIT.md instead of the default MR-REVIEW.md.
remote-sandbox-sync.sh warns but does not fail when no .z-harness-rsync-exclude is found.
remote-sandbox-sync.sh seed_base: failed rsync cleans up partial base dir before releasing lock to avoid a dangerously incomplete base.
run-status.sh classify --command implement-all: a TASKS.md with zero checkboxes is treated as incomplete (guards against wrong TASKS.md path).
run-status.sh last-event reads the last 20 lines of events.jsonl, iterating in reverse to find the latest valid JSON line.

morning-report.py _build_recommended_next: halt reason no_ask_blocked or unknown_ask_blocked shows lint-askuser.sh remediation steps with question_id; slug_collision_halt shows conflicting artifact and slug; skill_tool_failure shows captured error message.
morning-report.py emits CRITICAL HEAD SHA mismatch banner when head_sha_mismatch_at_resume event found in events.jsonl.
overnight-preflight.sh uses Z_HARNESS_SLUG env var for the slug in the emitted event; falls back to basename of --base if unset.
lint-askuser.sh --strict makes the script advisory-fail for CI; the default (no --strict) always exits 0 regardless of findings.
preflight.sh is documentation/audit tooling, not runtime enforcement; unregistered AskUserQuestion callsites under Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt still block until the user responds.

sink-lock.sh acquire: when LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB fails (BlockingIOError), exit 1 immediately — no stale-takeover is possible without the OS lock. Stale-takeover only occurs when we DO hold the OS flock and find stale JSON content.

sink-add-helpers.py recommended-command validation uses two checks: shlex.split for parseability + _unquoted_metachar for unquoted shell metacharacters; quoting metacharacters inside args is permitted.
sink-add-helpers.py Z_HARNESS_FOLLOWUP_LOCK_TIMEOUT env var overrides the 30s default lock timeout (for tests).
sink-claim-helpers.py staleness check: commit-distance window defaults to 50 (read from config followup.staleness_commit_window); --allow-stale bypasses the check but logs the drift.

sink-claim-helpers.py stale-takeover path requires a brief global-lock upgrade to write recovery events before proceeding; releases global lock immediately after, then continues with only the per-entry lock.
sink-status-set-impl.py: the 'done' terminal state can still transition to 'dismissed'; 'dismissed' has no outgoing edges and exits 3 on any attempted transition.

sink-view-rebuild.sh two-check approach: JSON content check (primary, sink-lock.sh compatible) OR OS flock sentinel check (legacy compat for callers holding raw OS flock). Either passing is sufficient.
sink-audit-validate.py check numbers (1-11) are stable and used by callers to identify which check failed; do not renumber.

sink-auto-close-check.py ** glob matching follows gitignore semantics: '*.md' matches only root-level .md files; '**/*.md' matches at any depth; denylist patterns like 'commands/**/*.md' prevent auto-close for command docs.
notion-push.py Retry-After header in Notion rate-limit responses is parsed and honored; falls back to next BACKOFF_SCHEDULE value if header absent or unparseable.
followup-reconcile-notion-impl.py detects pending entries by scanning JSONL for the latest notion-related event per entry_id; notion_synced or notion_sync_cleared clears the pending flag.
parse-followups-block.py COMMAND_RE allows a single-letter command (e.g. '/z-x') in addition to multi-char kebab; required fields missing from an entry log a warning and skip that entry.
validate-followup-schemas.sh blob_hash mutex test dynamically creates a temp JSON file by injecting dir_blob_hashes into the valid fixture; temp files are cleaned up unconditionally.
